message.content: {"window_id":"w0024","observed_failures":[{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","note":"Date extracted as 2018-08-09 but receipt header shows 09/03/2018; month/day order confusion on DD/MM/YYYY input"},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","note":"Returned 702.00; receipt shows Grand Total 92.80 and Cash Received 100.00. Likely picked up an unrelated numeric or OCR-corrupted 'Total' line"},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","note":"Returned 23.26 (pre-rounding 'Total Inclusive of GST') instead of final printed TOTAL after Rounding Adj (23.25). Priority scan picked earlier Total line before final TOTAL."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","note":"Returned empty string instead of null; fallback produced no value and code wrote '' rather than None/empty cell"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"RC1","summary":"Date parser misinterprets DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY","detail":"DATE_PATTERNS tries %d/%m/%Y first but fallback or alternative orderings can still match earlier regex when strings like '09/03/2018' appear; no locale hint or rejection of impossible day>12 disambiguation leading to swapped month/day for cases like 034.jpg."},{"id":"RC2","summary":"Total selector does not prefer the LAST matching priority line","detail":"When multiple lines satisfy the same priority tier (e.g., 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' followed by 'TOTAL: 23.25' after rounding), algorithm returns the first match in reading order. For receipts with rounding adjustments the final printed total is the last tier-matching line, not the first."},{"id":"RC3","summary":"Fallback to last-number-on-next-line mis-triggers on payment lines","detail":"When the keyword line has no numeric value (e.g., OCR lost it), the next-line fallback can pick a non-total line (change/visa/cash) if exclusion check isn't applied to the fallback line or if OCR text differs from the exclusion vocabulary (e.g., 'Visa', 'Cash Received'). 074.jpg's 702.00 and 078.jpg behaviour are consistent with this."},{"id":"RC4","summary":"Missing/unparseable values written as empty string, not real null","detail":"078.jpg total_amount is '' rather than an empty (None) cell. The writer path does not convert '' -> None before to_excel, violating the strict-schema contract."},{"id":"RC5","summary":"Exclusion keyword list is incomplete/narrow","detail":"EXCLUSIONS covers SUBTOTAL/TAX/GST/SST/DISCOUNT/CHANGE/CASH TENDERED but misses payment-method lines (VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CARD, PAYMENT, CASH RECEIVED, AMOUNT TENDERED, CHANGE DUE, TOTAL GROSS when it duplicates fuel total, AVERAGE/PAX) and totals-adjacent noise (ROUNDING ADJ, ROUNDED TOTAL vs TOTAL ROUNDED ambiguity). Allows wrong candidate lines to be selected or wrong fallback."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority/exclusion algorithm picks first matching line per tier instead of the LAST matching line within the same tier; two-line fallback does not re-check exclusions on the fallback line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion vocabulary is too small for Malaysian receipts: missing VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CARD, PAYMENT, CASH, CASH RECEIVED, AMOUNT TENDERED, CHANGE DUE, ROUNDING, ROUND(ED) ADJ, TOTAL GROSS (for fuel receipts where it duplicates Total), AVERAGE/PAX."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"extract_date returns first regex match without disambiguating ambiguous numeric date formats; no sanity check (day<=12 vs >12), and no preference for a date appearing near 'Date:' label vs other numeric strings; multi-pass OCR text concatenation can surface a different date (e.g., print time) ahead of the real purchase date."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Receipts with 'Rounding Adj' followed by a second 'TOTAL' line (post-rounding) are not handled — algorithm does not know that the final printed total supersedes earlier tier matches."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No vote/aggregation across multi-pass OCR variants: variants disagree (e.g., 23.25 vs 23.26) and the pipeline keeps the first variant's answer rather than the majority value."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Strict-schema writer accepts empty strings in the output DataFrame; does not coerce '' / 'None' / 'NaN' / 'nan' to real None before to_excel, producing non-null cells where the contract requires empty cells."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No post-write verification that every total_amount string matches /^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$/ and every date matches /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/ or is empty; this would have caught the 078.jpg '' before submission."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"In structured total extraction, within each priority tier collect ALL matching lines and return the LAST one (bottom-most) that passes exclusions; only fall through to lower tiers if no tier-N line yields a parseable number. This handles rounding-adjusted receipts where the final printed TOTAL is below an earlier tier match."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Re-apply the exclusion check to the fallback (next) line used when a keyword line lacks a number. Skip the fallback (and try the line after) if the candidate line contains any exclusion token, and never accept a fallback number from a line whose keyword itself is a payment/tender/change indicator."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSIONS to include payment/tender/change/rounding terms common on receipts: VISA, MASTERCARD, DEBIT, CARD, PAYMENT, CASH, CASH RECEIVED, AMOUNT TENDERED, CHANGE DUE, ROUNDING, ROUND ADJ, ROUNDING ADJ, ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT, TOTAL GROSS (fuel receipts), AVERAGE, PAX, ITEM COUNT, QTY, POINTS, SAVINGS. Also treat 'TOTAL GROSS' and 'TOTAL EXCL GST' as exclusions when a plain 'TOTAL' line exists."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a majority-vote aggregator across OCR preprocessing variants: run extract_total on each variant, then return the modal string value; ties broken by (a) highest-priority tier that produced it, (b) variant with highest average OCR confidence. Same voting for extract_date."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Make extract_date prefer a match that occurs on or immediately after a line containing 'DATE', 'TARIKH', 'INVOICE DATE', or 'RECEIPT DATE'. If multiple candidates exist, prefer the one closest in text to such a label; otherwise use the earliest match. Add a sanity check: if day>12 and month>12 both appear possible, prefer DD/MM for Malaysian/EU receipts (document this assumption)."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document a two-line keyword/value handling rule: when a keyword line (TOTAL, GRAND TOTAL, AMOUNT DUE) has no numeric and the next line has only a number, require that the number be formatted as N.NN (two decimals) and not be preceded by a currency-less integer alone (to avoid picking item counts)."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a self-check step: parsed total_amount must satisfy regex ^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$ with value in a plausible receipt range (0.10–100000.00); otherwise return None. Parsed date must satisfy ^(20\\d{2})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$; otherwise return None."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"In the strict-schema writer, after building the DataFrame, replace '', 'None', 'NaN', 'nan', numpy.nan in the output columns with Python None (e.g., df = df.where(df.astype(str).apply(lambda s: s.str.strip()).ne('').where(lambda x: x, other=False), None) or df.replace({'': None, 'None': None, 'NaN': None, 'nan': None}) and then astype('object'))."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a mandatory post-write verification block for extraction tasks: re-read the xlsx, assert exactly one sheet with the required name, assert exact column order and header text, assert row count equals input count, assert lexicographic filename ordering, and assert each non-null total_amount matches ^\\d+\\.\\d{2}$ and each non-null date matches ^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$. Fail loudly if any check fails so the agent fixes before finishing."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Document that for graded extraction outputs, every cell must be a literal string or a real null; never write Python floats or format-dependent values, and never leave helper columns like confidence/raw_text in the final sheet."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit guidance and example code for 'final printed total supersedes earlier pre-rounding total' — i.e., search for a 'ROUNDING' or 'ROUND(ED) ADJ' line and, if present, prefer a TOTAL/GRAND TOTAL/NET TOTAL line that appears AFTER it over any earlier total match."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add guidance that for fuel receipts, 'Total Gross' is typically a duplicate of 'Total' and should be excluded from candidate selection when a plain 'Total RM <value>' line is present; pick the plain Total line."}],"confidence":0.78}
